description: Use when a saved creator identity is wrong or incomplete. Change it by `identityId`: rename it (`name`), change its `note` or clear it with an empty string, add accounts (`addAccounts`) or remove them (`removeAccounts`). An added account already in another identity is refused with that identity named. An identity keeps at least one account; to drop the last, use delete_creator_identity. No cost to call.

evidence.description: What showed these are one person, e.g. suggest_creator_identity's evidence.

note.description: New note; an empty string clears it.

name: update_creator_identity
title: Update Creator Identity
